notes.title: Dualikiwi 1.2.2
notes.content:
Fix several UI bugs, mostly controller-related. Fixed issues include:
- Custom Level Theme sometimes set to Desert unexpectedly.
- Text input fields not escapable on controller.
- Popup panels don't prevent background UI elements from being selectable for controllers, preventing level deletion, creation, etc.

As part of these changes:
- Move to Unity 6

notes.title: Dualikiwi 1.2.0
notes.content:
This update adds several features to Dualikiwi:

Custom Level Completion Indicator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972352/064b90b1dbfd56284e8b602929db587ba1200d7f.png

After completing a level from the Level Browser, it will be given a green "Completed" Badge. Levels with this badge can be used in collections using the new World Creator!

World Creator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972352/e91c147d2298552e35a956b4db1bd61857562927.png

Players can now create Worlds i.e. level collections in-game using Badge-Verified levels!

From the "Workshop" menu, select the "+" button. Then choose the levels you want in your world, in the order you want them to appear, and hit the "+" to create your world!

After a world is created, it can be uploaded to the Steam Workshop using the "up arrow" button in the Workshop menu.

notes.title: Dualikiwi 1.1.0: Workshop Support
notes.content:
This update gives users the ability to create "Worlds", i.e. collections of their custom levels, to be shared on the Steam Workshop. Workshop Guide

Additional changes / bugfixes:

 Add support for deleting custom levels.
 Lose screen no longer appears after restarting a recently failed level.
 New custom levels should no longer unexpectedly be in the "Forest" tileset.

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello all! It's been great to read + hear that folks are enjoying the game! This change is for fixing a bug which slipped through the cracks:

- Fix a broken transition found when navigating away from the final level using a keyboard shortcut / controller button
